subject.title: Feature: preserve completed progress draft in Telegram progress mode

question: Should Telegram progress mode gain a default-off completed-draft preservation option, and should it preserve the full current draft or a structured checklist/progress-card representation?
rationale: Current main deliberately collapses the progress window to a one-line summary, while the requested behavior adds config, retention, and presentation policy that automation cannot choose safely.

options.title: Design default-off preservation
options.body: Specify the config name, full-draft versus structured checklist semantics, retention/redaction expectations, docs, tests, and live Telegram proof before implementation.

options.title: Keep one-line collapse summary
options.body: Treat the current summary bar as the supported post-final Telegram progress artifact and decline full completed-draft preservation for now.

options.title: Defer to structured progress cards
options.body: Keep this open or split follow-up work until a cross-channel structured progress-card API can represent checklist state consistently.

recommendation.title: Design default-off preservation
recommendation.body: Specify the config name, full-draft versus structured checklist semantics, retention/redaction expectations, docs, tests, and live Telegram proof before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: Their recent commits define the current Telegram progress-window collapse behavior that this feature would alter.
